{{Quote|Sumar to Captain Syndor. There has been an incident with Commander Faal. All brain activity has ceased. You are once again the commander of the ''Winged Dagger''. Congratulations, Commander.''"<br />"''Thank you.|Sumar and Syndor|<ref name="Allies" />}}
'''Syndor''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who served as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Winged Dagger]]'' in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. In [[44 ABY]] he was under the command of [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], who had allied with [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to defeat the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] being [[Abeloth]]&mdash;although the Sith actually intended to betray Skywalker and force Abeloth to serve them. During the mission, Syndor's command of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was transferred by Taalon to the Sith [[Leeha Faal]], whom he gave orders to raid a sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|fountain]] on [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]]&mdash;orders which Faal relayed to the frigate ''[[Starstalker]]'' to carry out.

The [[Violation|raid]] was successful, but both vessels were captured by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who were [[Treaty of Vontor|bound]] to protect the fountain. Because the ''Winged Dagger'' had not actually assisted in the assault, however, Syndor, Faal, and the rest of the ship's crew were allowed to go free. The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] eventually proceeded to [[Abeloth's planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where Skywalker, Faal, Taalon, and [[Sith Saber|Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] separated their minds from their bodies to [[Mind Walking|travel]] [[beyond shadows]] in hopes of locating Abeloth. Faal [[Death/Legends|died]] there, however, and aboard the ''Winged Dagger'', her [[Brain/Legends|brain]] activity ceased. [[Sumar]] reported the turn of events to Syndor, who was then reinstated by default as [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the vessel. He ordered the crew to remove Faal from life support and await further orders from Taalon. The Sith and Jedi eventually found Abeloth, but the Sith's betrayal failed and Skywalker defeated the dark side entity. The Sith fleet was then ordered to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Biography==
[[File:Lost_Sith_Tribe_world.jpg|thumb|right|290px|Syndor's homeworld of Kesh]]
{{Quote|Incoming message, Captain. From Commander Sarasu Taalon.|Syndor, relaying a message from Taalon to Faal|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Syndor was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] born on the<ref name="Allies" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. A member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] that had been isolated on Kesh<ref name="Allies" /> for [[5000 BBY/Legends|5,000 years]],<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Paragon]]''</ref> Syndor joined the Tribe's [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith armada]] sometime after its formation<ref name="Allies" /> in [[41 ABY]],<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Omen">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]''</ref> becoming [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] ''[[Winged Dagger]]'' by [[44 ABY]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he was chosen to accompany a task force of eleven ChaseMasters under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]] for a mission to form a feigned alliance with [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to find the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], who had been causing a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] among the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. In actuality, the Sith intended to betray the Jedi and force Abeloth to serve the Tribe. Syndor and the armada intercepted Skywalker over [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and convinced him to ally with them for the [[Mission to the Maw|mission]], which they claimed was to defeat Abeloth so as to prevent her from continuing to spread the psychosis.<ref name="Allies" />

The [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] stopped first at the planet [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine]] in the [[Si'Klaata Cluster/Legends|Si'Klaata Cluster]] to await Skywalker's friend, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], who was to join them with a [[Colossus I Beta Series asteroid tug]], the ''[[Rockhound]]'', for assistance in navigating [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], where Abeloth lived. Eventually, the allies decided to leave Klatooine and await Calrissian just outside the Maw; however, Taalon convinced Skywalker to allow him to leave two frigates behind in case something went wrong. The ''Winged Dagger'' was one of the two frigates, but the High Lord gave command of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] over to his close friend, the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] Sith [[Leeha Faal]], and made Syndor her second in command. Syndor pretended to take his demotion lightly when Faal took her station aboard the ''Winged Dagger'', but she still suspected that he planned to betray her. Following the rest of the allied fleet's departure from Klatooine, Faal relayed Taalon's orders to [[Violation|raid]] the planet's sacred [[Fountain of Ancients|Fountain of the Ancients]] to the ''[[Starstalker]]'', the second ChaseMaster that had been chosen to remain behind.<ref name="Allies" />

The raid proved successful, as samples of [[wintrium]]&mdash;the [[Glass/Legends|glass]]-like substance that made up the Fountain&mdash;were taken, but both the ''Winged Dagger'' and the ''Starstalker'' were apprehended by a task force of [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], who were bound by the [[Treaty of Vontor]] to protect the Fountain. Syndor, Faal, and the crews of both Sith ships were then brought to trial before Calrissian and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], both of whom had just arrived in-[[Star system/Legends|system]]. According to the Treaty of Vontor, two or more offworlders had to serve as judges during a trial regarding a possible violation of the Treaty, because both the Klatooinians and the Hutts had vested interests in the conclusion of such a case. During the trial, Faal claimed that the crew of the ''Starstalker'' had acted completely of their own accord when they attacked the Fountain. Even though Solo and Calrissian realized that she was lying, they had no proof and were thus only able to convict the ''Starstalker''{{'s}} crew of the crime of damaging the sacred Fountain.<ref name="Allies" />

[[File:Luke-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|160px|Jedi Grand Master Luke Skywalker]]
Calrissian, Solo, and the crew of the ''Winged Dagger'' then left Klatooine and met up with the rest of the allied fleet just outside of the Maw. After stopping briefly at [[Sinkhole Station]]&mdash;the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] where Skywalker had first encountered Abeloth&mdash;only to find it destroyed, they traveled to [[Abeloth's planet]]. There, Skywalker, Taalon, Faal, and the [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] separated their minds from their bodies in order to [[Mind Walking|walk]] [[beyond shadows]]&mdash;a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that consisted of locations corresponding to real places on Abeloth's world&mdash;in the hopes of locating Abeloth. Syndor, meanwhile, remained aboard the ''Winged Dagger'', where Faal's body was being monitored. While beyond shadows, Faal was dragged down into the [[Depths of Eternity]], from which no one could be retrieved or saved. Back on the ship, her [[Brain/Legends|brain]] activity ceased.<ref name="Allies" />

Syndor was informed by the female Sith [[Sumar]], who had been attending Faal, of the development and affirmed his resumed command of the vessel. Syndor then ordered that Faal be taken off life support and commanded the ship's crew to await further orders from Taalon. Although they failed to locate Abeloth while beyond shadows, the Sith and Jedi eventually found the dark side entity and battled with her. In spite of the Sith's attempted betrayal of the Jedi, Skywalker defeated Abeloth. Afterward, Taalon and Skywalker agreed to send Calrissian, Solo, and the entirety of the Sith fleet&mdash;including Syndor and the ''Winged Dagger''&mdash;offworld while they continued investigating Abeloth.<ref name="Allies" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Terminate life support and report back to your stations. We will await orders from High Lord Taalon.|Syndor, after Faal's brain activity ceased|<ref name="Allies" />}}
Following his placement as second in command beneath Leeha Faal, Syndor acted as though he was unbothered by his demotion, and dutifully carried out his orders. Faal, however, assumed that he was plotting to remove her from power. On Abeloth's planet, after Faal's sudden cessation of brain activity, Syndor ordered his crew to terminate her life support and return to their stations to wait for further orders from Taalon. Syndor was pleased by Faal's death, and did not hide his delight from his crew.<ref name="Allies" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|You have selected only the strongest and most powerful Sith for this mission.|Gavar Khai to Sarasu Taalon, regarding the members of the Sith fleet serving under Taalon|<ref name="Allies" />}}
As a member of the Lost Tribe from Kesh, Syndor was Force-sensitive and [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the Sith. He was entrusted with the command of the ChaseMaster frigate ''Winged Dagger''. Syndor was also considered to be exceptionally powerful, as only the strongest Sith in the Tribe had been chosen to accompany High Lord Sarasu Taalon on his mission. Despite this, Syndor was demoted by Taalon and replaced by the High Lord's close friend Leeha Faal, so that she could personally oversee the carrying out of his orders to raid the Fountain.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
Syndor first appeared in the fifth novel of the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', written by [[Christie Golden]] and released on [[May 25]], [[2010]].
